# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For UltimaMCP, target .NET 10/C# 14 and build a high-performance ASP.NET Core Minimal API/MCP bridge over the actual referenced Ultima SDK, validating SDK APIs directly rather than guessing; expose Ultima asset data useful to ServUO/ModernUO and AI coding tools.

## General Guidelines
- Prefer direct workspace edits with no explanatory change narration or historical notes in README files; keep responses minimal and keep README documentation limited to current behavior without change history.
- Keep responses concise to avoid wasted tokens.
